bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
ids="$(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll)"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$ids" | grep -c .)" -eq 1 || exit 71
id="$ids"
tag="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Config.Image}}' "$id")"
test "$tag" = "create-videobot:creator-entry-faaae3e" || exit 72
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$id")" = true || exit 73
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$id")" = "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$tag")" || exit 74
docker run --rm --pull never --network none --read-only --entrypoint node "$tag" --input-type=module -e 'import {menuPage} from "./src/telegram/menuPanel.mjs";import {createCreatorBotUpdateHandler} from "./src/telegram/creatorBot.mjs";const buttons=menuPage("home").reply_markup.inline_keyboard[0];if(buttons.length!==2||buttons[0].callback_data!=="menu:listing"||buttons[1].callback_data!=="menu:stickers")process.exit(78);if(typeof createCreatorBotUpdateHandler!=="function")process.exit(79);console.log("CREATOR_VIDEO_STICKER_DIRECT_EDITOR_ROUTES=PASS");'
echo CREATOR_POST_DEPLOY_IMAGE_READBACK=PASS
echo CREATOR_POST_DEPLOY_POLLER_COUNT=1
echo CREATOR_POST_DEPLOY_VERSION=faaae3e
